# Station 1: kidney model
setup: Kidney model, frontal section. Pins A to D.
image: images/station1.png

A. Name the structure at pin A.
= renal pelvis

B. Name the structure at pin B.
= renal pyramid

C. Name the structure at pin C.
= renal cortex | cortex

D. Name the structure at pin D.
= ureter

# Station 2: kidney slide
setup: Microscope, kidney slide, 4x. Pointers A to D.

A. Name the structure at pointer A.
= cortex | renal cortex

B. Name the structure at pointer B.
= medulla | renal medulla

C. Name the structure at pointer C.
= renal column

D. Name the structure at pointer D.
= renal capsule | capsule

setup: Urinary system model. Pins A to D.

A. Name the structure at pin A.
= urethra

B. Name the structure at pin B.
= kidney

C. Name the structure at pin C.
= urinary bladder | bladder

D. Name the structure at pin D.
= ureter

# Station 4: glomerulus slide
setup: Microscope, kidney slide, 40x, pointer on a glomerulus.

A. Name the structure at pointer A.
= simple squamous epithelium | Simple squamous
~ stratified squamous epithelium

B. Name the structure at pointer B.
= fenestrated capillary | fenestrated

C. Name the structure at pointer C.
= glomerulus

D. Name the structure at pointer D.
= podocyte

# Station 5: bladder model
setup: Bladder model, opened. Pins A to D.

A. Name the structure at pin A.
= ureter

B. Name the structure at pin B.
= urinary bladder | bladder

C. Name the structure at pin C.
= detrusor muscle | detrusor

D. Name the structure at pin D.
= internal urethral sphincter

# Station 6: nephron model
setup: Nephron model. Pins A to D.

A. Name the structure at pin A.
= afferent arteriole | afferent artery
~ afferent vessel | Afferent capillary

B. Name the structure at pin B.
= vasa recta

C. Name the structure at pin C.
= efferent arteriole

D. Name the structure at pin D.
= peritubular capillaries

# Station 7: food tests 1
setup: Four test tubes after the Biuret and Benedict tests, labeled A to D.

A. Which macromolecule does the result in tube A show?
= protein
~ amino acids

B. Which macromolecule does the result in tube B show?
= carbohydrates | Amylose | Starch | starches
~ Glucose | Sugar

C. Which macromolecule does the result in tube C show?
= lipid | fat

D. Which macromolecule does the result in tube D show?
= nucleic acid

# Station 8: food tests 2
setup: Four test tubes after the iodine test, labeled A to D.

A. Which macromolecule does the result in tube A show?
= amylose | starch
~ carbohydrates

B. Which macromolecule does the result in tube B show?
= sugars | monosaccharides | glucose | simple sugars

C. Which macromolecule does the result in tube C show?
= protein

D. Which macromolecule does the result in tube D show?
= lipids | fats
